# nobus_database (Resource)

A Nobus managed database. Size, compute flavor, and the customer password can be changed in place through their dedicated API operations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "database_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "nobus_database" "example" {
  name              = "orders"
  user_email        = "dba@example.com"
  flavor_name       = "standard"
  database_type     = "postgresql"
  database_version  = "16"
  size              = 100
  install_type      = "single"
  customer_username = "orders_admin"
  customer_password = var.database_password
  zones             = ["nobus-wa-az1"]
  encrypted         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_password` (String, Sensitive) Changing this value calls the database credential-rotation endpoint.
- `customer_username` (String)
- `database_type` (String)
- `database_version` (String)
- `flavor_name` (String) Flavor name used during initial provisioning.
- `install_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `size` (Number) Database volume size in GB. It can only be increased.
- `user_email` (String)
- `zones` (List of String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `encrypted` (Boolean)
- `flavor_id` (String) Flavor ID used by the resize-flavor API. Changing it resizes the database instances.
- `project_id` (String)
- `zabbix_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instance_count` (Number)
- `instances_json` (String, Sensitive)
- `status` (String)
- `task_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nobus_database.example DATABASE_ID
```
